generate_init_prompt: generate a random chit-chat starting prompt message from the curated list of greeting messages
generate_safe_response: generate a safe fallback response that avoids sensitive topics and steers conversation to a new topic
review_STARTING_PROMPT_MESSAGES: review the tuple of curated starting prompt messages used for initiating chit-chat conversations
review_AVOID: review the tuple of avoidance phrases used to deflect from sensitive or inappropriate topics
review_TOPIC: review the tuple of safe conversation topics used to steer dialogue toward neutral subjects
